entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) ultra-wide shot from behind the figure at shoulder height, strong lens distortion so the room bends toward the centre.
entries.subject: A hooded silhouette seen from behind stands in a vaulted stone chamber, one hand raised. Pale tendrils of translucent psychic light unfurl from the back of the figure's head like slow ribbons of thought, drifting through the room. Where they touch, space warps: floor tiles, candle flames and stone benches are stretched into a spiral and pulled toward a small bright point of collapse hovering before the open palm, the arches bending around it as if seen through a lens. Strange non-legible glyph shapes flicker in the air.

entries.camera: Symmetrical centred medium-wide shot from behind at ground level, the figure strongly silhouetted against a blinding light source.
entries.subject: A figure seen from behind, in pure silhouette, stands on a wide pale stair with arms slightly open. From the shoulder blades unfold two vast wings of radiant light, each feather a bright streak, the outer feathers dissolving into drifting sparks that fall like slow snow onto the steps. A single great shaft of dawn light pours down from a high round opening ahead, the figure perfectly centred against it, the stair and a wide empty hall below carved in soft glow. No halo, no symbols, no faces.
entries.accent: pearl white and rose-gold dawn light

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, perfectly symmetrical, wide lens, the circular floor filling the whole frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at the round stone floor of a circular chamber, a tiny hooded figure stands at its centre with arms thrown wide. Around it the floor is split into wedges like a wheel of chance, each wedge erupting with a different random spell effect: a burst of flame, a patch of frost, a spiral of flower petals, a swarm of small butterflies, a heap of tumbling feathers, a column of soap bubbles, a crackle of lightning, a pool of liquid gold. The effects overlap and spill chaotically across the dividing lines.
entries.accent: riotous multicolour sparks: orange, cyan, lime and yellow

entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at hand height, 100mm look, very shallow depth of field, the scales in razor focus.
entries.subject: A forearm and hand cropped at the elbow, in extreme close-up. The wrist is smooth skin, but toward the knuckles it turns into overlapping glittering ruby-red scales edged with gold, the nails drawn out into dark curved claws. The hand opens to cup a small perfect curl of dragonfire that hovers above the palm and lights every scale. Behind, out of focus, a cavern floor heaped with gold coins, goblets and gems glitters in the firelight.
entries.accent: ruby red and ember orange with gold edges

entries.camera: Long-lens profile at ground level, compressed perspective, the hound walking across the frame left to right.
entries.subject: A colossal hound made of living shadow and smoke walks in profile through a moonlit ruined colonnade, its two eyes a pair of cold pale points, its edges unravelling into streamers of darkness that crawl across the floor and climb the broken pillars, swallowing the moonlight as they go. A small hooded figure seen from behind walks at its side, one hand lowered, fingertips trailing thin threads of shadow that lead to the calm, obedient hound. Fallen leaves and ash drift in its wake.
entries.accent: ink black with a sickly pale green glow

entries.camera: Extreme wide shot from far away at sea level, the figure tiny, enormous scale and depth, a heavy storm filling most of the frame.
entries.subject: A tiny silhouetted figure stands on the top of a rocky sea stack with arms raised, in front of a colossal swirling supercell that fills the sky. Rain falls in sheets all around, but a perfect dry circle opens in it around the figure, as if the storm bows aside. Forked lightning arcs between the figure's fingertips and the cloud wall, and the sea below climbs in towering white-crested waves around the base of the stack. Wind tears the figure's cloak sideways.
entries.accent: slate grey storm with electric white-blue lightning

entries.camera: Side-on horizontal close-up still life at workbench level, 85mm look, shallow depth of field, the mechanism sharp and centred.
entries.subject: A hovering armillary of plain, unmarked interlocking brass rings, gears and escapements floats above a cluttered workbench, each ring turning in a different plane at a different speed, a soft amber light glowing at its core and thin lines of light tracing the perfect meshing of the teeth. A few small loose cogs and springs hang in the air mid-turn. On the bench below: calipers, a loupe, a small hammer and open drawers of tiny gears, all precisely lined up. No people.
entries.accent: polished brass and bronze with a warm amber glow

entries.camera: Low-angle wide shot from the grass looking up through a ring of standing stones toward the sky, wide lens, strong vertical lines.
entries.subject: A figure seen from behind and below stands in the centre of a ring of tall standing stones on a moor at night, arms lifted. Above, three moons hang in a gentle arc: a thin crescent, a half and a full silver disc, each sending down its own beam of pale light that pools like liquid on the stones and the grass. Silver motes drift upward from the figure's open hands toward the moons. Wisps of cloud and a scatter of stars frame the sky.
entries.accent: silver moonlight and deep midnight indigo

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder close view from behind and slightly to one side of the figure, medium lens, the open palm and the shattered orb ahead in focus.
entries.subject: Seen from behind and just over the shoulder of a figure standing in a dark ruined hall, a crown of white-gold flame floats above the head and golden fire runs in ribbons down the arms. Ahead, a glass orb on a pedestal has shattered, and ribbons of loose multicoloured arcane energy spiral out of it through the air; the figure's open palm draws them in, and they turn into a blazing white-gold flame in the palm. Embers drift and the broken arches glow.
entries.accent: dazzling white-gold spellfire with teal shadows
